description: This file defines the I18NTranslationImportAPI class, an API endpoint for importing internationalization translation files into the system. It handles file upload, validation, processing of XLIFF files, and updating translation strings in multiple languages within the HRM system.

classes.name: I18NTranslationImportAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint for importing translation files (XLIFF/XML) into the system for a specific language, handling validation, processing, and updating translation strings.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the import of a translation file for a given language, processes the file, updates translations, and returns a summary of success, failure, and skipped entries.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create endpoint, validating 'languageId' and 'attachment' parameters.
